order_id.description: Order identifier. Integer >= 1; a CSV cell is text, so the decimal-string form is accepted too.

quantity.description: Units ordered. Integer >= 1; a CSV cell is text, so the decimal-string form is accepted too.

unit_price_cents.description: Unit price in cents. Integer >= 0, since a free line is a legal price; a CSV cell is text, so the decimal-string form is accepted too.
